subject: Relaxing most of the time..
author: ZombieTron
body:
I am definitely spending most of the time relaxing, I am really glad that I am not working anymore. I have found that I am getting tired easily and have taken to having afternoon naps on most days.

Otherwise, I am mostly taking nice slow walks in the woods and chilling out watching day time TV.

I really should play more Xbox as I have the time too, but my motivation for gaming has gone out the window along with my waistline!

I am enjoying my last few months of me time, although I can't wait to meet my bump in person! and I think they might feel the same way as it feels like they are trying to punch their way out of my belly on most days too!!

Glad you enjoyed E3, there were some very interesting developments to keep an eye on for the future. I loved all the Project Natal stuff, full of possibilities! 🙂

subject: too many stresses
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: you should really be taking it easy..🏝️....i know its hard when you have so much to do......they say that moving house and having a baby are 2 of the most stressful things a woman can ever encounter in her life......and youre doing both at the same time ..WTF.... you need to chill and relax and enjoy being pregnant.....you wont have time to yourself at all when you have your little baby..🏃...so make the most of it......im so happy for you an xandu and i cant wait to see pics of your little one up here on the site....lol and hear all your stories of what he/she has been getting up to.....your almost making me broody lol.....anyway ill see you in the tournament zombs you take it easy :) oh 🎵 and i hear rofer and kevlar are planning a duo for a lullaby for you ....🎵... should make your little angel sleep peacefully all night :)

subject: You should
author: Linkster
body:
definitely be taking it easy.  Enjoy your me time and with any luck for the first couple of months your wee babeh will spend a lot of time asleep giving you a bit of time for gaming.

 

As for your waist line don't worry about it.  My wife looked positively glowing when she was preggers and a lot of women do.  I think it's a very good look.

 

I hope all is going well for you in Norway and if it's any consolation it's done nothing but piss down with rain where I am for the last 4 days.
